review_comments.body: Opening a link in a fullscreen table leaves the fullscreen focus trap active behind the link\-safety modal\, so Tab redirects focus away from the modal’s controls\.

comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 is attempting to deploy a commit to the **Vercel** Team on [Vercel](https://vercel.com).

A member of the Team first needs to [authorize it](https://vercel.com/git/authorize?team=Vercel&slug=vercel&teamId=team_nLlpyC6REAqxydlFKbrMDlud&type=github&job=%7B%22headInfo%22%3A%7B%22sha%22%3A%22d7dc05543551b8f5ed3fbdb5b8bc08d597cd6993%22%7D%2C%22id%22%3A%22QmcGAyGHJ2BFQvDhH8H3cowz2BkcyKrAzoPBDXXzZVCZPu%22%2C%22org%22%3A%22vercel%22%2C%22prId%22%3A742%2C%22repo%22%3A%22streamdown%22%7D).

Thanks @pcbeingused333, this is a solid a11y fix. Moving focus in, trapping Tab and restoring focus on close is exactly the right pattern.

Two things before we can move forward:

1. Please check the Vercel bot's review comment on `use-dialog-focus.ts`. The trap pulls focus back whenever it lands outside the dialog, and that blocks the link-safety modal opened from links inside a fullscreen table.
2. Another PR has since landed that closed #731, so please merge `main` into your branch and see what's still needed on top of it.
Closing in favour of #743, which covers this. Thanks!
